title: Explicit simplicial attachment and refinement
statement: For a truncated finite split etale hypercover U through n [def-weil-pbc-finite-split-replacement-stage], an etale X-scheme V, boundary data Q and b:V to Q.M, construct the top term as V coproduct the old nondegenerate objects indexed by proper surjections out of [n+1]. Construct every simplicial operator via the old splitting cofans and epi-mono factorizations. The resulting truncated functor restricts exactly to U.simplicial. Given a stage A with underlying U and a compatible map g:V to K_(n+1), construct a natural transformation of this attached functor to K whose restriction is exactly A.f, after the canonical equality transport.

proof.text: Define old degeneracies by the old splitting cofan universal property: precompose the epi label and include the resulting old top summand. Define faces by binary and indexed coproduct descents, using b followed by Q.pi on V and old operators on old summands.

For arbitrary operators to the top factor through the ordinal image. Prove independence under strong epi-mono factorization using the unique image isomorphism and compatibility of concatenated epi labels. The mixed face, lift and endomorphism composition identities imply every composition law in the four old/top cases. Package the resulting functor and prove its exact old restriction by functor extensionality.

Define the top refinement by g on V and A.f followed by the associated K-degeneracy on each old summand. Prove face naturality by coproduct extensionality and the assumed boundary equations; prove epi naturality by splitting cofan extensionality and A.f.naturality. Image factorization gives lift and top-endomorphism naturality. The four old/top cases give a natural transformation. Its restriction equals A.f after the proved functor equality transport.
